decision: Not registered. Root assigns family IDs, pins source/export/control hashes and adapts the GPU runner on this NEW code version; first-batch sources stay immutable. No N/G decision from this family.
purpose: Explain direct-head performance by capacity, input information and regularization (one disclosed change per arm vs the CUDA flatten_mlp 128 control), not hyperparameter search.

control.arm: control of DRAFT-CUDA-DIRECT-20261004 (MatrixModel flatten_mlp width 128, 141834 parameters, AdamW wd .01, no dropout, all inputs)
control.reuse_rule: Reuse the base-batch CUDA control fits ONLY if model code (matrix_models.py hash), training loop/budget, export manifest SHA256, device class and torch/CUDA runtime are identical; otherwise refit the control in this family with the same seeds.
control.parameter_formula: flatten_mlp params = h^2 + 298 h + 10, h = 2*width, n_flat = 6*(38+1)+52 = 286

context_schema.source: SequenceContext.transform (0-10 game state/flags; 11-27 Archetypes.numeric_features = 6 standardized style rates, 6 reliabilities, 5 soft memberships LAST), SharingContext pitcher profile (CLUSTER_FEATURES, left_share, type_*), log1p(TRAIN count)/10; routing 7 columns stripped by training_arrays
context_schema.names_function: direct_frontier_model.direct_context_names(clusters['columns']); exporter must write the 52 ordered names and the runner must pass them to build_frontier for information arms

families.capacity: plain flatten_mlp at the residual / periodic parameter counts (within 1%): separates 'more parameters' from 'different architecture' for the frozen residual and periodic arms
families.information: same network and parameter count; named inputs zeroed in fit AND predict (mask archived with the model); history drop marks past tokens invalid and keeps the current token and all context
families.regularization: dropout only, weight decay only, both (separate arms isolate each component; the 'both' arm is a two-component bundle)

comparison.scope: descriptive repeated-DEV only; per family vs the control; no winner before all 24 fits complete
comparison.metrics: same Mac scoring path as DRAFT-CUDA-DIRECT-20261004 (temperature, June blend, paired whole-game bootstrap)

data_rules: No 2026 rows. Inputs are the DRAFT-CUDA-DIRECT-20261004 export (plus context names). DEV/mlb_dev only predicted, never used for fit, early stop, temperature or selection.
